 from collections.abc import Iterable

+from orderkit.models import Order, OrderStatus
 
 
 class OrderRepository:
@@ -13,9 +13,24 @@
     def __init__(self, orders: Iterable[Order] = ()) -> None:
         self._orders = list(orders)
 
-    def list_orders(self) -> list[Order]:
-        """返回全部订单。"""
-        return list(self._orders)
+    def list_orders(self, status: OrderStatus | str | None = None) -> list[Order]:
+        """返回订单；给定 status 时只返回状态匹配的订单。"""
+        if status is None:
+            return list(self._orders)
+        wanted = self._parse_status(status)
+        return [order for order in self._orders if order.status == wanted]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _parse_status(status: OrderStatus | str) -> OrderStatus:
+        """把状态入参归一化为 OrderStatus，非法取值抛出 ValueError。"""
+        if isinstance(status, OrderStatus):
+            return status
+        text = str(status).strip().lower()
+        for member in OrderStatus:
+            if member.value == text:
+                return member
+        legal = ", ".join(member.value for member in OrderStatus)
+        raise ValueError(f"unknown status {status!r}; legal status values are: {legal}")
 
     def find_by_id(self, order_id: str) -> Order | None:
         """按订单号查找订单，找不到时返回 None。"""
